payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all subarrays via two nested loops, compute product incrementally and sum per subarray, count those where product equals sum. Plain exhaustive search without pruning or bounding.
payload.rationale: The solution is a straightforward complete search over subarrays, not using backtracking, bitmask, or graph traversal. Among the given subtypes, search_branch_and_bound is the closest fit despite lacking explicit bounding, as it still generates candidate subarrays sequentially.
